title: Amazon - Marketing Manager And Graphic Designer
description:
Overview

Position: Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer - Amazon

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $ per month

About the Role

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines
  • Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Storefront design
  • Comfortable collaborating, giving / receiving constructive feedback, and backing creative opinions with data and rationale
  • Tools : Adobe Photoshop; Google Sheets; familiarity with Amazon A+ Content modules and Seller tools
  • Advanced fluency in English is required (written and verbal)

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with packaging design and / or 3D mockup tools (e.g., Adobe Dimension, Blender)
  • Basic copywriting and understanding of marketing psychology for conversion-focused messaging
  • Experience leveraging ChatGPT to streamline creative workflows and project management
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout systems and component libraries
  • Photo retouching and light color-grading for skincare / lifestyle imagery

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

How to Apply

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here’s what to expect :

  • Complete the application form (you’ll be sent the link after expressing interest)
  • Screening interview with our recruitment team
  • Interview with the client
  • Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

We’re looking forward to learning more about you!

Job Type : Full-time

Application Question(s)

  • If we must fill this position urgently. Can you start immediately?
  • In case we need to fill the vacancy in 2 weeks or 1 month would you be able to wait?
  • Can you work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment?
  • Are you available for regular client review meetings and internal status calls?
  • Do you agree with the proposed salary in the Job post for a full time based job and monthly?
  • Are you comfortable working in a remote setting?
  • Are you willing to undergo a background check, in accordance with local law / regulations?
  • This is an independent contractor type of hiring. If you want to proceed please choose yes.
  • How many years of experience do you have designing Amazon listing images?
  • Have you previously designed visuals for beauty or skincare products?
  • Are you proficient in Adobe Photoshop?
  • Do you have experience creating Amazon A+ Content and Storefront designs?
  • Are you familiar with Amazon’s image guidelines for product listings?
  • Are you familiar with Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout and component libraries?

Language : english (Required)

title: Vaga: Especialista Em Ux (User Experience Designer)
description:
Overview

Vaga: Especialista em UX (User Experience Designer)

Modalidade: Remoto

Atuação: Em Horário Comercial

Modelo de Contrato: PJ

Desafio

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em UX com experiência sólida em desenho de interfaces (UI) e arquitetura de sistemas digitais, que será responsável por entender as necessidades dos usuários e traduzi-las em telas intuitivas, funcionais e com excelente usabilidade. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com times de produto, desenvolvimento e negócios para propor soluções eficazes e centradas no usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar e entender requisitos de negócios e necessidades dos usuários.
  • Criar fluxos de navegação, wireframes, protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade.
  • Elaborar telas com foco em usabilidade, acessibilidade e experiência do usuário.
  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade e entrevistas.
  • Mapear jornadas e pontos de fricção em sistemas atuais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, POs e desenvolvedores para garantir a entrega de produtos coesos e bem projetados.
  • Documentar padrões e guias de interface.
  • Participar de reuniões de concepção de produtos e soluções técnicas.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Design, HCI, Psicologia Cognitiva, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em design de sistemas (Design Systems), acessibilidade e heurísticas de Nielsen.
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa UX, testes de usabilidade e métricas de experiência.
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos técnicos e de negócio em soluções visuais e funcionais.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Noções de HTML / CSS para facilitar a comunicação com desenvolvedores.
  • Experiência anterior com produtos SaaS, ERPs ou plataformas complexas.
  • Portfólio com projetos de design de sistemas e interfaces reais.

title: Sdr Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um SDR Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative) dinâmico, proativo e especialista em prospecção B2B para integrar nosso time, focado no mercado dos Estados Unidos. Este profissional será a força motriz por trás da expansão do nosso projeto SaaS.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e otimizar campanhas de prospecção e conexão com leads dentro do nosso ICP (Ideal Customer Profile), utilizando ferramentas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dux, etc.
  • Identificar dores, desafios e oportunidades dos leads que possam ser solucionados pela nossa empresa, para personalizar a abordagem de vendas.
  • Realizar pesquisa e análise prévia do perfil da empresa a ser contatada, bem como dos decisores (decision-makers) que serão convidados para a demonstração.
  • Qualificar leads de forma estratégica, utilizando técnicas de pesquisa para garantir que apenas as oportunidades mais promissoras avancem no funil de vendas.
  • Efetuar cold calls e buscar contatos via redes sociais corporativas, visando agendar o maior número de demonstrações qualificadas possíveis.
  • Enviar mensagens personalizadas no LinkedIn e e-mails para leads qualificados, com o objetivo de gerar conexão, educar o mercado e despertar interesse no produto.
  • Realizar follow-ups constantes para nutrir o relacionamento com potenciais clientes, criando um cenário favorável para a conversão após a demonstração.
  • Manter o CRM (Hubspot) e outras planilhas internas meticulosamente atualizadas, registrando todas as interações e o progresso dos leads.
  • Gerir ativamente a agenda de demonstrações, incluindo marcação, confirmação e reagendamentos, atuando sempre com atenção e proatividade.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas (Closers) para garantir que as reuniões agendadas sejam altamente produtivas, fornecendo todo o contexto necessário sobre o lead.

Você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental, ou seja, alinhar o conhecimento técnico e as formas de tratativa com os clientes, para que eles compreendam as estratégias e como elas se encaixam.

Essa vaga é direcionada a planejadores e assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil a ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capital e a vaga, que terá início em 13 / 10 / 25 :

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos / soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;

Pré-requisitos

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;

Diferencial

  • Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;

Overview

Job Description

The Cox Automotive Fixed Operations Performance Manager plays a critical role in driving value and retention across the Dealer Solutions portfolio—including F&I, DMS, and Xtime Service products—for franchise and large independent automotive dealers. This role is designed for professionals with deep retail automotive experience , especially in fixed operations , who can translate dealership challenges into actionable solutions using Cox Automotive’s suite of technologies.

This position is ideal for someone who has managed or worked extensively within dealership service departments , understands the nuances of dealership operations, and can serve as a trusted advisor to clients. The Operations Performance Manager is the primary point of contact for Dealertrack and Xtime solutions and is responsible for maximizing product utilization, improving dealership performance, and driving organic growth.

This is a regional position and we are accepting applicants from the Pacific, Mountain, and select Central time zones .

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner to automotive dealerships, leveraging your hands-on dealership experience to drive adoption and performance of Cox Automotive solutions.
  • Evaluate dealership operations and align product usage with dealer goals, focusing on efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction .
  • Establish a regular cadence of in-store and virtual engagements to assess performance, identify gaps, and implement process improvements.
  • Apply your fixed ops expertise to optimize service lane operations using Xtime and related tools.
  • Identify upsell opportunities by understanding dealership pain points and recommending relevant solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with sales and product teams to ensure seamless integration of new offerings into dealership workflows.
  • Proactively manage at-risk accounts using a consultative, data-driven approach to retain and grow relationships.
  • Stay current on product updates and enhancements and communicate their value in the context of dealership operations.

What’s In It For You?

Here’s a sneak peek of the benefits you could experience as a Cox employee:

  • A competitive salary and top-notch bonus/incentive plans.
  • A pro-sales culture that honors what salespeople (like you!) contribute to our success.
  • Exceptional work-life balance, flexible time-off policies and accommodating work schedules.
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits, with multiple options for individuals and families.
  • Generous 401(k) retirement plans with company match.
  • Inclusive parental leave policies, plus comprehensive fertility coverage and adoption assistance.
  • Professional development and continuing education opportunities.
  • Access to financial wellness/planning resources.

Who You Are

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Safe drivers needed; valid driver\'s license required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years managing a fixed operations department or equivalent experience in a retail automotive dealership.
  • Deep understanding of dealership operations, including service, parts, and F&I.
  • Proven ability to influence dealership personnel at all levels—from service advisors to general managers.
  • Proficient in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and virtual collaboration tools.
  • Strong communication and listening skills, with the ability to uncover operational challenges and propose impactful solutions.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating cross-functionally.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. Atrium is Telos Media’s newest YouTube channel, from exploring inside Hitler's final hours to living in the horrifying conditions of Auschwitz. We take viewers to places that are now only accessible through animation and storytelling.

We’ve already had strong momentum, and now, we’re looking for a visionary Part-time 3D Camera Operator to help elevate our next videos.

This role is for someone who lives and breathes visual storytelling. You’ll work hand-in-hand with the Channel Director to map out the visual blueprint for each video—turning scripts into clear, engaging animatics that animators can then bring to life. Done right, your work sets the tone, style, and pacing of the visuals for each upload.

The goal is to take a 3D model we've created, like the inside of a submarine, and bring it to life using static characters and voice-over, all coming together into one final video. We\'re not looking to create test animatics or rough drafts. The aim is to go straight to producing the final version.

If you love storytelling and the process of visually bringing stories to life, then this is your chance to help build a premium content brand from the very beginning. Let’s make something incredible!

Responsibilities

  • Dig into scripts and understand the tone, message, and visual vibe
  • Create animatics that show camera movement, pacing, and animator notes
  • Collaborate with animators to make the vision come to life
  • Suggest visual solutions when something’s not clicking
  • Keep files and assets organized for smooth team access
  • Review final videos, gather feedback, and improve for next time

Must Haves

  • Several years of animation industry experience — YouTube, TV, or film
  • Knows Blender well enough to create the animatics inside it
  • Can adjust visual style depending on the script
  • Has a sharp eye for camera angles, timing, and transitions
  • Knows how to make microscopic or abstract concepts cinematic
  • Can create animatics that feel — emotionally powerful moments that land
  • Brings ideas to the table, not just drawings
  • Is constantly studying great visuals — from movies to sci-fi to docs
  • Is proactive, fast to respond, and excited to grow with us

Good to Haves

  • Can manage animation timelines and teams (as we scale)
  • Understand YouTube audience retention and how visuals play a part
  • Have a strong network of creatives in the space
  • Know how visuals can tap into emotion and psychology
  • Happy to jump in and help across the production process

Key Obsessions (What are you obsessed with?)

  • Obsessed with Visual Storytelling: Always thinking about how to tell a story visually — framing, pacing, movement, and how every shot contributes to the narrative.
  • Obsessed with Viewer Engagement: Constantly asking: “Will this keep the viewer watching?” They look at retention graphs, know how to build hooks, and design moments that emotionally land.
  • Obsessed with Efficiency: Loves building systems that speed things up. They design animatics that are clear, production-ready, and save the animators hours of guesswork.
  • Obsessed with Detail, Without Getting Slowed Down: They notice when a transition doesn’t feel right or a shot lacks emotional punch — but they also know how to move fast and not get stuck.
  • Obsessed with Growth & New Styles: Always exploring fresh visual techniques, studying references from all kinds of media, and pushing the style to evolve beyond the “usual.

Pré-requisitos

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;

Diferencial

  • Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá

  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos / produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Se você busca um alto potencial de remuneração e deseja atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital.

Você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental, ou seja, alinhar o conhecimento técnico e as formas de tratativa com os clientes, para que eles compreendam as estratégias e como elas se encaixam.

Essa vaga é direcionada a planejadores e assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil a ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita l e a vaga, que terá início em 13 / 10 / 25 :

O Grupo Capital

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam batermetas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos / soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro / Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial

  • Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos / produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação

  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a forward-thinking technology company dedicated to building innovative and scalable solutions that optimize data processing and analytics. They foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and proactive problem-solving, empowering their teams to drive meaningful impact in the digital space.


Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Accessibility Tester to join our team. The Accessibility Tester will evaluate digital products, including websites, applications, and documents, to ensure compliance with accessibility standards such as WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines). This role is critical to ensuring an inclusive experience for all users, particularly those with disabilities

Responsibilities

Accessibility Testing:

  • Conduct manual and automated testing to ensure digital content and features comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1, Section 508, ADA).

  • Use tools such as screen readers (e.g., JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), accessibility checkers (e.g., Axe, WAVE), and other testing tools.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Identify and document accessibility issues, including barriers faced by users with visual, auditory, cognitive, or motor disabilities.

  • Provide clear and actionable feedback to development teams and stakeholders.

  • Prioritize issues based on impact and severity.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with designers, developers, and content creators to guide accessibility best practices.

  • Participate in accessibility review meetings to discuss findings and solutions.

Training and Advocacy:

  • Stay updated on the latest accessibility standards, tools, and techniques.

  • Educate team members on accessibility requirements and advocate for inclusive design.

Documentation:

  • Maintain detailed records of test results and issue resolution.

  • Assist in creating accessibility documentation, such as conformance statements and VPATs (Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates)

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in accessibility testing and evaluation across web, mobile web, and native applications

  • Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2, Section 508, and ARIA

  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript from an accessibility standpoint

  • Hands-on experience with assistive technologies and tools (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver; Axe, WAVE, ANDI, Accessibility Insights, AccessAssistant)

  • Deep expertise in at least one screen reader (JAWS or NVDA) and one testing tool/plugin

  • Experience creating or contributing to accessibility documentation, including VPATs

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Ability to work independently and proactively with cross-functional teams

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider for technology, financial services, insurance, law, and medicine. By combining machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies with a global workforce and high-security infrastructure, we help advance AI. Innodata offers digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts that assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Analista Governança e Controle Pleno - VMO | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

Descrição da vaga

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo. Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança. Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG. Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos. O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.
  • Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências.
  • Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.
  • Levanta e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.
  • Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos.
  • Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle.
  • Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização.
  • Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais.
  • Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para correções de rumo.
  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.
  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado).
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.
  • Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi).
  • Automação de processos. Ex: VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365.
  • Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO.
  • Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera.
  • Programação no Power BI.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

Overview

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Digital Care 2 You é uma healthtech comprometida com a transformação digital da saúde pública e suplementar por meio da inovação responsável. Atuamos com soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, Big Data e interoperabilidade de sistemas, com foco em segurança clínica, ética, conformidade e impacto real na jornada do paciente.

Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente.

Principais Atividades:

  • Mapeamento e análise de requisitos com times multiprofissionais.
  • Integração de dados.
  • Desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de IA em saúde.
  • Criação de ferramentas automatizadas.
  • Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.
  • Garantia de segurança, anonimização, ética e conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de IA.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Domínio de Python, R, Java Script, SQL, React, Node ou similares e bibliotecas de IA.
  • Experiência com integração de dados em saúde e padrões de interoperabilidade.
  • Portfólio técnico ou publicações científicas em projetos de IA em saúde.
  • Conhecimento da LGPD e princípios éticos para uso de IA.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência com projetos na área de saúde.
  • Participação em iniciativas nacionais ou internacionais de interoperabilidade.
  • Certificações técnicas.

title: [Monks] CRM Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the (Monks) CRM Specialist role at Brasil Monks . This is a 100% remote opportunity with the CRM team at Monks, focused on planning, execution and optimization of CRM strategies across channels.

We are the largest digital marketing agency in Latin America, working with big brands, and offer development opportunities through training programs on major marketing platforms. The CRM team handles the design and validation of responsive HTML emails, configuration of campaigns in marketing automation tools, segmentation, scheduling, and the creation and maintenance of email journeys, with results analysis and KPI reporting to drive improvements.

Ideal candidates enjoy development, fast learning and analytical capability, and can adapt to each project to find best solutions. You will actively participate in client project delivery with support for learning and career growth, from home.

Responsibilities and duties

  • Work within a multidisciplinary squad (with internal CRM leadership) in direct contact with the client, implementing the CRM communication strategy proposed by the client in the CRM Insider platform.
  • Operate the CRM Insider platform using Email, Push, SMS and WhatsApp channels.
  • Create and adjust responsive email templates in HTML.
  • Create and maintain segmentations for sending based on existing data in the CRM platform.
  • Create and schedule timely sends of Email, Push, SMS and WhatsApp.
  • Create and maintain automation journeys/flows for Email, Push, SMS and WhatsApp.
  • Measure campaign results with KPIs such as delivery rate, open rate, click-through rate and conversion; derive insights to propose improvements and optimization.
  • Provide strategic support to the client to identify points to adjust and improve the proposed strategy.

Tools and methodologies

  • Marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, among others.
  • Google tools (Sheets, Slides, Docs).
  • Internal collaboration tools (Slack, Google Chat).
  • Agile methodologies.

What you will learn and develop

  • CRM strategies and personalized client communication.
  • Management of digital marketing campaigns and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Technical specialization in the project-targeted platform.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experience operating CRM/Email marketing platforms such as Insider, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, among others.
  • Proficiency in HTML for emails.
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics; Google Sheets, Slides and Docs.
  • Experience analyzing CRM campaign results (delivery, opens, clicks) and business metrics (conversion rate, target attainment).
  • Experience with inbound campaigns and orchestration of automated email/Push/SMS/WhatsApp flows.
  • Ability to work autonomously in multidisciplinary squads.
  • Knowledge of at least one programming language.

Differentials

  • Fluent or advanced English (reading, writing, speaking, listening).
  • Experience with Insider CRM platform.
  • Experience with WhatsApp strategy.
  • CRM platform certifications.
  • SQL proficiency.

Informações adicionais

What we offer: flexible meal/food allowance card, health plan, dental plan, flexible work hours and location, home-office allowance, access to wellness platforms, birthday leave, maternity/paternity leave, wellbeing and mental health resources, partnerships with educational institutions, and our Talent Development team to support knowledge growth. description:
Overview

Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer - Amazon

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $ per month

About the Role :

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company :

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines
  • Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Storefront design
  • Comfortable collaborating, giving / receiving constructive feedback, and backing creative opinions with data and rationale
  • Tools : Adobe Photoshop; Google Sheets; familiarity with Amazon A+ Content modules and Seller tools
  • Advanced fluency in English is required (written and verbal)

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with packaging design and / or 3D mockup tools (e.g., Adobe Dimension, Blender)
  • Basic copywriting and understanding of marketing psychology for conversion-focused messaging
  • Experience leveraging ChatGPT to streamline creative workflows and project management
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout systems and component libraries
  • Photo retouching and light color-grading for skincare / lifestyle imagery

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

How to Apply

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here’s what to expect :

  • Complete the application form (you’ll be sent the link after expressing interest)
  • Screening interview with our recruitment team
  • Interview with the client
  • Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

We’re looking forward to learning more about you!

Job Type : Full-time

description:
Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

About Us :

Bitcoinsensus is a leading entity in the cryptocurrency space, committed to sharing knowledge through multiple social media platforms and our website. We’re focused on real-time market analysis, comprehensive guides, industry news, and insightful reviews, serving a diverse audience ranging from blockchain and crypto beginners to experts.

Overview

Are you passionate about creating seamless and intuitive user experiences that shape the way people interact with digital financial solutions? Bitcoinsensus is seeking a full-time UX Design Lead to join our growing team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive user-centered design strategies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and craft innovative solutions in the fast-evolving crypto and fintech space.

Your Role

As our UX Design Lead, you will :

  • Lead the design and development of user experiences for Bitcoinsensus platforms, ensuring usability and accessibility.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand detailed business and user requirements.
  • Conduct research and user testing to identify customer needs and pain points.
  • Translate insights into design strategies and deliver cohesive, innovative user interfaces.
  • Partner with developers, product owners, and QA engineers to ensure design specifications are implemented effectively.
  • Stay updated with the latest UX trends, tools, and best practices, bringing forward improvements to enhance user satisfaction.

Job Requirements :

  • Minimum of 3 years in UX design, ideally with experience leading enterprise or fintech / crypto projects.
  • Strong proficiency in tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar.
  • Proven track record of delivering successful UX solutions backed by research and testing.
  • Excellent understanding of usability principles and user psychology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your UX design process and results.

Ideal Candidate :

  • A detail-oriented professional with passion for design innovation.
  • Experience in Agile workflows (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Self-disciplined, organized, and able to handle responsibilities independently.
  • A collaborative team player who thrives on shared success.
  • Curious, ambitious, and eager to learn, grow, and push design boundaries.

Can Be an Advantage :

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design or a related field.
  • Advanced certifications in UX design.

Why Join Us?

At Bitcoinsensus, you’ll join a dynamic and forward-thinking environment where innovation meets impact.

  • Top talent & collaboration: Work alongside inspiring colleagues and contribute to a culture of learning and growth.
  • Cutting-edge projects: Stay ahead of the curve by shaping digital experiences in fintech and crypto.
  • Ownership & autonomy: We trust you to take responsibility for your commitments, innovate, and make meaningful design decisions.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy a non-micromanaged environment and flexible schedule.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

Benefits :

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use :

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job :

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You :

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities :

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects , including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance .

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model .
  • Proven track record in data migration projects , including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar .
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing .
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Job Title: Psychology Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered solutions, partnering with 4 of the top 5 global technology companies and serving over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide. With operations in 13 global locations and a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts, we are at the forefront of innovation in machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language model (LLM) training.

By combining deep domain expertise, advanced AI / ML technologies, and secure infrastructure, Innodata is shaping the future of AI systems and making them smarter, safer, and more contextually aware.

About the Role

We are seeking a Psychology Subject Matter Expert (SME) with exceptional analytical, writing, and research skills to join our AI / LLM training team. You will play a key role in developing, curating, and evaluating psychology-related content to train AI models in psychological concepts, theories, and applied practices. This role is ideal for psychologists, researchers, educators, and mental health professionals passionate about leveraging their expertise to enhance AI’s understanding of psychology and human behavior.

Responsibilities

  • Content Development
    • Create high-quality psychology content, including:
    • Theoretical explanations of psychological frameworks and concepts.
    • Research-based case studies, assessments, and intervention examples.
    • Summaries of key psychological theories, studies, and experiments.
    • Content across major domains: Cognitive Psychology; Developmental Psychology; Clinical & Counseling Psychology; Social Psychology; Behavioral and Neuropsychology; Industrial-Organizational Psychology; Psychometrics and Psychological Testing.
  • Model Evaluation & AI Training
    • Review and refine AI-generated psychology content for accuracy, clarity, and sensitivity.
    • Identify and correct conceptual errors, cultural biases, and ethical concerns.
    • Design rubrics and evaluation criteria for AI model reasoning in psychological contexts.
  • Research & Collaboration
    • Collaborate with AI researchers, computational linguists, and engineers to improve AI reasoning in psychology.
    • Provide expert input for datasets covering mental health, psychological assessment, and therapy practices.
    • Support ethical and culturally sensitive approaches to psychological topics in AI models.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master’s or PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong academic and / or applied experience in one or more areas: Clinical, Counseling, or Health Psychology; Developmental or Educational Psychology; Cognitive or Behavioral Sciences; Psychometrics and Research Methods.
  • Demonstrated expertise in academic writing, research, or content development.
  • Ability to synthesize complex theories and present them clearly for diverse audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with AI / ML concepts, NLP, or data annotation (a plus).
  • Understanding of mental health ethics, confidentiality, and cultural competence.
  • Experience with psychological assessments, surveys, and statistical tools.

Why Join Innodata?

  • Help shape how AI models understand human behavior and mental health.
  • Work with global teams of researchers, linguists, and engineers.
  • Contribute to next-generation AI technologies that promote psychological insights.
  • Enjoy a remote-first, flexible work environment and research-driven culture.

Additional Information

  • Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment.
  • Mandatory and non-billable step.

Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain's growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain's application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container/Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web/API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain's architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React/React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM/AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

Who We Are

Rain is filled with people with a deeply rooted passion for our mission, who embrace diversity throughout our global team, and grow personally and professionally. We own what we do and let data guide our actions while working quickly and adapting to new challenges every day. title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Process Automation
description:
Senior Software Engineer, AI Process Automation

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Software Engineer, AI Process Automation to join our cutting edge AI & Automation team. In this role, you\'ll be the architect of our internal operational efficiency. Your primary mission is to identify, design, and deploy intelligent automation solutions that eliminate manual work, accelerate our data analysis, and empower our teams to focus on high-value challenges in the blockchain intelligence landscape.

This is a high-impact position with a clear and ambitious goal: within your first six months, you will be expected to deliver a portfolio of automations that saves a cumulative 80 hours of manual work per week across the company.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead the discovery and analysis of business processes across all departments, identifying high-impact opportunities for automation and process re-engineering.
  • Develop complex integrations between our core systems and third-party applications, including Jira, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Notion, Google Workspace, and our core data warehouse in BigQuery.
  • Pioneer the use of AI within our automations, building agentic workflows, leveraging LLMs for tasks like content summarization and data reconciliation, and implementing robust evaluation frameworks to measure model effectiveness.
  • Serve as the platform owner for our core AI and automation tech stack. This includes working alongside our Infrastructure teams managing the environments to ensure reliability and performance, as well as enhancing the user experience (UX) to empower other teams to build their own automations effectively.
  • Champion and enforce stringent security standards in all automations, ensuring the secure handling of sensitive data and implementing best practices for encryption, access control, and secure API usage in partnership with our security team.
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of automation projects from initial ideation and requirements gathering with stakeholders to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in process automation, software development, or a similar role, with a strong portfolio of successfully deployed projects that delivered measurable business value.
  • Expert-level proficiency with at least one enterprise-grade low-code/no-code automation platform (e.g., n8n, Make). You should know its limitations and have a strong understanding of best practices to implement when working with the tools.
  • Proficiency in software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices. You should be comfortable using version control (Git) for your projects and understand the principles of automated testing and CI/CD to build robust and maintainable automations.
  • Deep expertise in business process mapping, requirements gathering, and designing scalable, fault-tolerant workflow architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting complex, multi-system API integrations and solving the challenges that come with them.
  • A security-first mindset with proven experience building systems that handle sensitive or confidential data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive and autonomous work ethic. You can take a high-level goal, break it down into actionable steps, and drive it to completion.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building agentic workflows or integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) for tasks like NLP, data extraction, or content generation.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and services (GCP, AWS).
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts and writing complex SQL queries (especially for BigQuery).
  • A genuine interest in the blockchain, cryptocurrency, or FinTech space.

Life at TRM Labs

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description—we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
